faq1a: Tap Send money, choose the country, type your family member's name and number, and enter the amount. You see the fee and the total before you confirm.
faq2a: Before you confirm you always see the fee, the total you pay and what your family receives. Nothing is hidden.
faq3q: How do I follow my transfer?
faq3a: Open History. Each transfer shows four steps: Saved on phone, Received, Processing and Ready to collect.
faq4q: What if I have no internet?
faq4a: You can still send. The transfer is saved on your phone and sent automatically when you are connected again. It says Saved on phone until then.
faq5q: Can I use Zarka without a smartphone?
faq5a: Yes. Dial the Zarka USSD code on any phone, or send a text such as SEND ZW 500 0771234567. No data is needed.
faq6q: How does my family collect the money?
faq6a: They get an SMS when the money is ready, with a reference number to show when they collect.
faq7q: Will my money be sent twice if my connection drops?
faq7a: No. Every transfer has its own unique ID, so if the app retries after a dropped connection, the money is only sent once.
